from: We missed the deadline in March, so we are paying a penalty now.
frame: If we ___ the deadline in March, we wouldn't be paying a penalty now.

ok.de: Ursache im März (had + 3. Form), Folge jetzt (now): wouldn't be.
ok.en: cause in March (had + participle), result now: wouldn't be.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort had fehlt: Der if-Teil braucht had + 3. Form.
wrong.en: the key word had is missing: the if-clause needs had + participle.

wrong.de: would gehört nicht in den if-Teil: dort steht had + 3. Form.
wrong.en: would does not belong in the if-clause: it takes had + participle.

from: Our CFO left in June, so we have no one to approve the budget now.
frame: If our CFO hadn't left in June, we ___ someone to approve the budget now.

ok.de: Richtig: would have. „hadn't left in June“ (früher) und „now“: Die Folge gilt jetzt, also would + Grundform.
ok.en: Right: would have. “Hadn't left in June” (earlier) and “now”: the result applies now, so would + base form.

wrong.de: would have had blickt auf damals zurück; now verlangt would + Grundform: would have someone.
wrong.en: would have had looks back to then; now needs would + base form: would have someone.

wrong.de: Nach would steht die Grundform, nicht had: would have someone.
wrong.en: after would comes the base form, not had: would have someone.

wrong.de: would have been wäre ein Satz über damals; now verlangt die Folge für jetzt.
wrong.en: would have been is about back then; now needs the result for the present.

from: Our process is slow, so we didn't win the bid.
frame: If our process were faster, we ___ the bid.

ok.de: Zustand jetzt (were), die Folge früher: would have + 3. Form.
ok.en: state now (were), result earlier: would have + participle.

wrong.de: Die Folge liegt in der Vergangenheit: would have won, nicht would win.
wrong.en: the result lies in the past: would have won, not would win.

wrong.de: Nach would steht have, nicht had: would have won.
wrong.en: after would comes have, not had: would have won.

from: Our manager is very cautious, so he didn't approve the pilot.
frame: If our manager were less cautious, he ___ the pilot.

ok.de: Eigenschaft jetzt (were), die Folge früher: would have + 3. Form.
ok.en: trait now (were), result earlier: would have + participle.

wrong.de: Die Entscheidung fiel früher: would have approved, nicht would approve.
wrong.en: the decision came earlier: would have approved, not would approve.

wrong.de: had approved gehört in den if-Teil; im Hauptsatz steht would have approved.
wrong.en: had approved belongs in the if-clause; the main clause has would have approved.

from: Unfortunately, I can't attend the workshop this week.
frame: I wish ___ attend the workshop this week.

ok.de: Richtig: I could. Wunsch über eine Fähigkeit jetzt: wish + could. „can“ ändert sich nach wish zu could.
ok.en: Right: I could. A wish about an ability now: wish + could. “Can” changes to could after wish.

wrong.de: can bleibt im Präsens; nach wish rückt die Form eine Stufe zurück.
wrong.en: can stays present; after wish the verb moves one step back.

wrong.de: would fordert Verhalten anderer; die eigene Fähigkeit heißt could.
wrong.en: would asks others to change; your own ability is could.

from: It's a pity that the client is so inflexible about dates.
frame: I wish the client ___ about dates.

ok.de: Richtig: were more flexible. Ein Wunsch für jetzt: wish + Past, bei be steht were (auch bei „the client“).
ok.en: Right: were more flexible. A wish about now: wish + Past, and be becomes were (even with “the client”).

wrong.de: is bleibt im Präsens; nach wish rückt die Form eine Stufe zurück.
wrong.en: is stays present; after wish the verb moves one step back.

wrong.de: would be wünscht anderes Verhalten; ein Zustand jetzt braucht were.
wrong.en: would be wishes for other behavior; a state now needs were.

from: I regret sending the proposal without legal review.
frame: I wish I ___ the proposal without legal review.

ok.de: Richtig: hadn't sent. Das Bedauern gilt etwas Vergangenem („without legal review“): wish + hadn't + 3. Form.
ok.en: Right: hadn't sent. The regret is about something in the past (“without legal review”): wish + hadn't + participle.

wrong.de: Past Simple bleibt bei jetzt; Bedauern über früher braucht had + 3. Form.
wrong.en: simple past stays at now; regret about earlier needs had + participle.

wrong.de: Du bereust das Senden: Es muss verneint werden (hadn't sent).
wrong.en: you regret sending: it must be negative (hadn't sent).

from: It's a shame we didn't ask IT before the migration.
frame: If only we ___ IT before the migration!

ok.de: Richtig: had asked. „If only … before the migration“ ist ein Bedauern über Vergangenes: had + 3. Form.
ok.en: Right: had asked. “If only … before the migration” is regret about the past: had + participle.

wrong.de: would ask wünscht künftiges Verhalten; before the migration ist vorbei.
wrong.en: would ask wishes for future behavior; before the migration is over.

wrong.de: Past Simple bleibt bei jetzt; für früher braucht If only had asked.
wrong.en: simple past stays at now; for earlier, if only needs had asked.

from: It annoys me that you never confirm meeting times in advance.
frame: I wish you ___ meeting times in advance.

ok.de: Richtig: would confirm. Der Ärger über wiederholtes Verhalten („never confirm“) braucht wish + would.
ok.en: Right: would confirm. Annoyance at repeated behavior (“never confirm”) takes wish + would.

wrong.de: will steht nie nach wish; dieser Ärger braucht would.
wrong.en: will is never used after wish; this annoyance needs would.

wrong.de: had confirmed bedauert etwas Vergangenes; die Gewohnheit besteht weiter.
wrong.en: had confirmed regrets something past; the habit continues.

from: It annoys me that the vendor keeps changing the requirements.
frame: I wish the vendor ___ the requirements.

ok.de: Richtig: would stop changing. „keeps changing“ ist wiederholtes Verhalten, das enden soll: wish + would.
ok.en: Right: would stop changing. “Keeps changing” is repeated behavior that should end: wish + would.

wrong.de: will steht nie nach wish; hier braucht der Ärger would.
wrong.en: will is never used after wish; here the annoyance needs would.

wrong.de: Nach would steht die Grundform: would stop, nicht stops.
wrong.en: after would comes the base form: would stop, not stops.

from: Updating our onboarding process is long overdue.
frame: It's ___ we updated our onboarding process.

ok.de: It's high time + Subjekt + Past Simple: überfällig, jetzt wird gehandelt.
ok.en: It's high time + subject + past simple: overdue, act now.

wrong.de: „It's time we updated“ stimmt auch, sagt aber nicht „überfällig“. Gefragt: high/about/past time.
wrong.en: “It's time we updated” is correct too, but not “overdue”. Needed: high/about/past time.

wrong.de: Es fehlt high, about oder past vor time: It's high time we updated.
wrong.en: high, about or past is missing before time: It's high time we updated.

from: The team should start preparing for the audit now; it's overdue.
frame: It's high time the team ___ for the audit.

ok.de: It's high time + Past Simple: started, auch wenn es um jetzt geht.
ok.en: It's high time + past simple: started, even though it is about now.

wrong.de: Präsens start passt nicht: nach high time steht die Past-Form started.
wrong.en: present start does not fit: after high time use the past form started.

wrong.de: would gehört nicht nach high time; hier steht schlicht das Past.
wrong.en: would does not belong after high time; use the plain past here.

prompt: If we would have tested the patch earlier, we would have fewer outages now.
fixed: If we had tested the patch earlier, we would have fewer outages now.

ok.de: Im if-Teil steht had + 3. Form; would gehört nur in die Folge (now).
ok.en: the if-clause takes had + participle; would belongs only in the result (now).

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: im if-Teil darf kein would stehen.
wrong.en: there is an error: the if-clause cannot contain would.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort ist in Ordnung; der Fehler liegt bei would have im if-Teil.
wrong.en: this word is fine; the error is would have in the if-clause.

prompt: If the client had signed in May, we would have been busy now.
fixed: If the client had signed in May, we would be busy now.

ok.de: now verlangt die Folge für jetzt: would be, nicht would have been.
ok.en: now needs the result for the present: would be, not would have been.

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: Die Folge gilt jetzt, aber would have been blickt zurück.
wrong.en: there is an error: the result holds now, but would have been looks back.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler steckt in would have been neben now.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is in would have been next to now.

prompt: If I would be more patient, I would have waited for the quote.
fixed: If I were more patient, I would have waited for the quote.

ok.de: Im if-Teil steht hier die Past-Form, nicht would: If I were more patient (informell auch: was).
ok.en: Here the if-clause takes the past form, not would: If I were more patient (informal: was).

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: Nach if steht kein would, sondern die Past-Form.
wrong.en: there is an error: after if comes the past form, not would.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist would be im if-Teil.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is would be in the if-clause.

prompt: If our CTO were less cautious, we would have launched the beta in March.

ok.de: Richtig: were (der Zustand jetzt), would have launched (Folge früher).
ok.en: correct: were (state now), would have launched (result earlier).

wrong.de: Hier ist kein Fehler: were beschreibt den Zustand, would have launched das Frühere.
wrong.en: there is no error: were describes the state, would have launched the earlier result.

prompt: I wish I am less busy this quarter.
fixed: I wish I were less busy this quarter.

ok.de: Nach wish rückt die Form zurück: bei be were (oder umgangssprachlich was).
ok.en: after wish the verb steps back: were for be (or casual was).

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: am bleibt im Präsens, nach wish steht die Past-Form.
wrong.en: there is an error: am stays present, but wish takes the past form.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist am nach wish.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is am after wish.

prompt: I wish our system can handle more requests at once.
fixed: I wish our system could handle more requests at once.

ok.de: „wish“ braucht die Rückstufung: can wird could. „I wish our system could handle more requests.“
ok.en: “Wish” needs the step back: can becomes could. “I wish our system could handle more requests.”

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: can bleibt im Präsens, nach wish braucht es could.
wrong.en: there is an error: can stays present, but wish needs could.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist can nach wish.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is can after wish.

prompt: I wish I would have asked for the contract in writing.
fixed: I wish I had asked for the contract in writing.

ok.de: Bedauern über früher: wish + had + 3. Form, nicht would have.
ok.en: regret about earlier: wish + had + participle, not would have.

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: would have gehört nicht hinter wish; es braucht had.
wrong.en: there is an error: would have does not follow wish; it needs had.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist would have nach wish.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is would have after wish.

prompt: If only we didn't wait so long before contacting the client last week.
fixed: If only we hadn't waited so long before contacting the client last week.

ok.de: „last week“ ist vorbei: If only + hadn't waited. Das Past didn't wait würde sich auf jetzt beziehen.
ok.en: “Last week” is over: If only + hadn't waited. The Past didn't wait would refer to now.

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: Past Simple bleibt bei jetzt, es geht um früher.
wrong.en: there is an error: simple past stays at now, but this is about earlier.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist didn't wait.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is didn't wait.

prompt: I wish the client doesn't change the scope every week.
fixed: I wish the client wouldn't change the scope every week.

ok.de: „every week“ ist wiederholtes Verhalten, das stören soll: wish + wouldn't change. didn't change ginge auch, doch would ist natürlicher.
ok.en: “Every week” is repeated behavior that should stop: wish + wouldn't change. Didn't change would also work, but would is more natural.

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: das Präsens doesn't geht nach wish nicht.
wrong.en: there is an error: present doesn't does not work after wish.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist doesn't change nach wish.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is doesn't change after wish.

prompt: I wish you didn't interrupt me so often.

ok.de: Richtig: didn't interrupt beschreibt nur den Zustand, den ich nicht mag.
ok.en: correct: didn't interrupt only describes the state I dislike.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: wish + Past ist richtig; would stop wäre die Forderung.
wrong.en: no error: wish + past is correct; would stop would be the demand.

prompt: It's high time we will switch to a better ticketing tool.
fixed: It's high time we switched to a better ticketing tool.

ok.de: Nach It's high time steht das Past Simple, nie will.
ok.en: after It's high time comes the past simple, never will.

wrong.de: Doch, ein Fehler: will gibt es nach high time nicht.
wrong.en: there is an error: will does not follow high time.

wrong.de: Dieses Wort passt; der Fehler ist will switch nach high time.
wrong.en: this word fits; the error is will switch after high time.

prompt: It's high time our support team got a proper escalation process.

ok.de: Richtig: nach high time steht got (Past), gemeint ist jetzt.
ok.en: correct: after high time comes got (past), meaning now.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: High time + Past Simple (got) ist die richtige Form.
wrong.en: no error: high time + past simple (got) is the right form.

a: If we had signed the deal, we would be profitable today.
b: If we had signed the deal, we would have been profitable last year.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt, dass uns der Erfolg heute fehlt?
q.en: Which sentence says the success is missing today?

ok.de: today + would be: Die Folge gilt jetzt. b spricht von last year.
ok.en: today + would be: the result holds now. b is about last year.

wrong.de: would have been profitable last year nennt die Folge für früher.
wrong.en: would have been profitable last year gives the result for earlier.

a: If I were more careful, I would have caught the error.
b: If I had been more careful, I would have caught the error.

q.de: Welcher Satz beschreibt eine Eigenschaft, die heute noch gilt?
q.en: Which sentence describes a trait that is still true today?

ok.de: were beschreibt einen Zustand jetzt; b nennt nur das Verhalten damals.
ok.en: were describes a state now; b only names behavior back then.

wrong.de: had been careful liegt ganz in der Vergangenheit, nicht bei heute.
wrong.en: had been careful lies entirely in the past, not at today.

a: I wish I could join the call.
b: I wish I could have joined the call.

q.de: Welcher Satz handelt von einem Anruf, der noch bevorsteht oder läuft?
q.en: Which sentence is about a call that is still ahead or going on?

ok.de: could join wünscht etwas für jetzt; could have joined bedauert früher.
ok.en: could join wishes for now; could have joined regrets earlier.

wrong.de: could have joined blickt zurück: Der Call ist schon vorbei.
wrong.en: could have joined looks back: the call is already over.

a: I wish I had called the client yesterday.
b: I wish I could call the client now.

q.de: In welchem Satz bedauert der Sprecher etwas, das schon vorbei ist?
q.en: In which sentence does the speaker regret something that is already over?

ok.de: had called + yesterday: Bedauern über früher. b wünscht etwas für jetzt.
ok.en: had called + yesterday: regret about earlier. b wishes for now.

wrong.de: could call + now ist ein Wunsch über jetzt, kein Bedauern.
wrong.en: could call + now is a wish about now, not regret.

a: I wish you would stop interrupting me.
b: I wish I hadn't interrupted you.

q.de: In welchem Satz soll sich das Verhalten einer anderen Person ändern?
q.en: In which sentence should another person change what they do?

ok.de: wish + would stop: Du willst, dass der andere sein Verhalten ändert.
ok.en: wish + would stop: you want the other person to change.

wrong.de: hadn't interrupted bedauert das eigene frühere Verhalten.
wrong.en: hadn't interrupted regrets your own earlier behavior.

a: It's high time we updated the pricing.
b: We updated the pricing a while ago.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt, dass die Preisanpassung noch aussteht?
q.en: Which sentence says the pricing update is still to be done?

ok.de: high time + updated: Es ist überfällig und soll jetzt passieren.
ok.en: high time + updated: it is overdue and should happen now.

wrong.de: a while ago macht b zu einer abgeschlossenen Handlung.
wrong.en: a while ago makes b a finished action.
